sections.title: similar to anupallavi
lyrics: halavu pApangaLa hadhagEDisuva mantra - sulabhadhindhali svarga sUragombuva manthra

sections.title: charanam 2
lyrics: marutAthmaja nithya smaraNE mADuva manthra - sarva rishigaLalli sEridha manthra
similar to anupallavi - duritha kAnanakidhu dAvAnala manthra - porEdhu vibhIshaNagE paTTa kaTTida manthra
charanam 3 - snAna maunangaLigE sAdhanadha manthra - mAnvaru manadi dhyAnipa manthra
similar to anupallavi - hIna guNangaLa hingisuthiha mantra - yEnembE vibhIshaNagE sAravinibha manthra
charanam 4 - sakala vEdagaLige sAravEnipa manthra - mukuthi mArgake idE mUla manthra
similar to anupallavi - bhakuti rasakE ommebaTTe htOruva manthra - sukhanidhi purandara viTTalana mahA manthra
charanam 5 - jnAnanidhi namma Ananda thIrttaru - sAnurAgadhi nithya sEvipa manthra
similar to anupallavi - bhAnu kulAmbudhi sOmanenipa namma - dhInarakshaka purandhara viTTalana manthra
